name: Portugal
spiritual_teacher: Mooji (Monte Sahaja ashram, frequent satsangs in the south)
work_strategy: Hybrid / Remote (Comfortable living, great climate, community)
it_market: Medium (Growing market, though salaries are lower than major European hubs)
ua_fop_and_local_taxes: First 183 days 0 €; then progressive PIT + Segurança Social contributions; Ukrainian 5% single tax is not credited under DTT.
climate: Warm (Lots of sun, mild short winter, best climate in the EU)
nature: Ocean and hills (Atlantic access, top for surfing, mountains available)
english_level: Easy (High English proficiency among youth and in services; local language not mandatory)
housing_rent: Expensive (High prices for locals, but quite affordable on an IT salary)
citizenship: 5 years (One of the fastest in the EU; dual citizenship allowed)
mortgage_expats: Accessible (Banks are expat-friendly, lending up to 70–80% LTV)
rent_to_buy: Available (Arrendamento com opção de compra — deals can be found where part of rent goes toward down payment)

protection_and_aid_2026.entry_documents: Any document proving citizenship. 90/180-day visa-free entry. Biometric passport required for air travel.
protection_and_aid_2026.protection_status: Temporary protection for 1 year with extensions. Three key numbers are issued automatically: NIF (tax), NISS (social security), and NSNS (healthcare).
protection_and_aid_2026.military_liable_rule_2026: **From 31.07.2026, EU countries do not grant protection to conscription-liable persons without proof of legal exit and deferral.**
protection_and_aid_2026.social_benefits: Support for unemployed low-income individuals (RSI) — 189 €/mo per adult, 94.5 € per child. Stipend for Portuguese language courses (4.25 €/day for meals + 1.70 €/hr for study).
protection_and_aid_2026.housing_aid: Temporary reception center in Lisbon for initial days. State rent subsidy 'Porta de Entrada' (Gateway) for 18 to 30 months (state covers most of the rent).
protection_and_aid_2026.healthcare: National Health Service (SNS) is virtually free, on par with citizens. A platform of Ukrainian-speaking doctors operates.
protection_and_aid_2026.transport: One free CP train trip from the border to the settlement destination.
protection_and_aid_2026.work_rights: Automatic right to work. Support via IEFP employment centers.
